# README media

Assets embedded by the root [`README.md`](../../README.md).

## `demo.gif`

A guided tour of the built-in dashboard, embedded at the top of the README — it
autoplays and loops on GitHub. It replaces the old architecture flowchart, which
still lives in the
[System Overview](https://paulmeier.github.io/kasas/architecture/overview/).

The tour walks every surface: the transactions table (sort, paginate, inline
label editing, extensions, per-row relationships / history / provenance), manual
account & transaction entry, the search query language, the labels vocabulary,
rules (create + run over history), the live event stream, webhooks, and a
sandboxed plugin — ending with the plugin reacting to a brand-new transaction by
auto-applying a label and a schema extension.

`1080×675`, ~51s, ~1.8 MB. Generated by driving the live dashboard headlessly
over a deterministic `make seed` dataset, then assembling the frames with an
ffmpeg two-pass palette (best color/size for flat UI):

```sh
# frames/*.png -> optimized, looping gif (~0.9s per frame)
ffmpeg -y -framerate 1.1 -pattern_type glob -i 'frames/*.png' \
  -vf "scale=1080:-1:flags=lanczos,palettegen=stats_mode=full" palette.png
ffmpeg -y -framerate 1.1 -pattern_type glob -i 'frames/*.png' -i palette.png \
  -lavfi "scale=1080:-1:flags=lanczos[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=sierra2_4a" \
  -loop 0 demo.gif
```
